sys_script_include.description: Contains OOTB methods for access utility functions of Quote Related Party
sys_script_include.name: QuoteRelatedPartyUtilOOB
sys_script_include.script: var QuoteRelatedPartyUtilOOB = Class.create(); QuoteRelatedPartyUtilOOB.prototype = { initialize: function() {}, getPrimaryAccountAddress: function(account) { if (gs.nil(account)) return; var accountAddressGR = new GlideRecordSecure('account_address_relationship'); accountAddressGR.addQuery('account', account); accountAddressGR.addQuery('primary', true); accountAddressGR.query(); if (accountAddressGR.next()) { return accountAddressGR.getValue('sys_id'); } return null; }, createRecordsForSellerOrganization: function(quoteGr, types = []) { var sellerOrganization = quoteGr.getValue('seller_organization'); if (gs.nil(sellerOrganization)) return; var configGR = new GlideRecordSecure(QuoteConstants.RELATED_PARTY_CONFIGURATION_TABLE); configGR.addQuery('entity_type', global.CSMBaseConstants.SERVICE_ORGANIZATION_TABLE); if (types.length > 0) { configGR.addQuery('name', 'IN', types); } configGR.addQuery('applies_to', 'sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote'); configGR.query(); while (configGR.next()) { var relatedPartyGR = new GlideRecordSecure(QuoteConstants.QUOTE_RELATED_PARTY_ADDRESS_TABLE); relatedPartyGR.initialize(); relatedPartyGR.setValue('quote', quoteGr.getValue('sys_id')); relatedPartyGR.setValue('type', configGR.getValue('sys_id')); relatedPartyGR.setValue('order', configGR.getValue('default_order')); relatedPartyGR.setValue('seller_organization', sellerOrganization); relatedPartyGR.setValue('responsibility', configGR.getValue('default_responsibility')); relatedPartyGR.insert(); } }, createRecordsForAccount: function(quoteGr, types = []) { var account = quoteGr.getValue('account'); if (gs.nil(account)) return; var primaryAccountAddress = this.getPrimaryAccountAddress(account); var configGR = new GlideRecordSecure(QuoteConstants.RELATED_PARTY_CONFIGURATION_TABLE); configGR.addQuery('entity_type', global.CSMBaseConstants.ACCOUNT_TABLE); if (types.length > 0) { configGR.addQuery('name', 'IN', types); } configGR.addQuery('applies_to', 'sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote'); configGR.query(); while (configGR.next()) { var relatedPartyGR = new GlideRecordSecure(QuoteConstants.QUOTE_RELATED_PARTY_ADDRESS_TABLE); relatedPartyGR.initialize(); relatedPartyGR.setValue('quote', quoteGr.getValue('sys_id')); relatedPartyGR.setValue('type', configGR.getValue('sys_id')); relatedPartyGR.setValue('order', configGR.getValue('default_order')); relatedPartyGR.setValue('account', account); if (!gs.nil(primaryAccountAddress)) { relatedPartyGR.setValue('account_address', primaryAccountAddress); } relatedPartyGR.setValue('responsibility', configGR.getValue('default_responsibility')); relatedPartyGR.insert(); } }, createRelatedPartyRecords: function(quoteGr) { try { var routeToMarket = quoteGr.getValue('route_to_market'); var account = quoteGr.getValue('account'); var sellerOrganization = quoteGr.getValue('seller_organization'); if (gs.nil(routeToMarket)) return; if (routeToMarket == QuoteConstants.QUOTE_RELATED_PARTY_CONSTANTS.RTM_OPTIONS.DIRECT) { this.createRecordsForAccount(quoteGr); } else if (routeToMarket == QuoteConstants.QUOTE_RELATED_PARTY_CONSTANTS.RTM_OPTIONS.RESALE) { this.createRecordsForSellerOrganization(quoteGr, QuoteConstants.QUOTE_RELATED_PARTY_CONSTANTS.RTM_RESALE.CHANNEL_PARTNER_ROLES); this.createRecordsForAccount(quoteGr, QuoteConstants.QUOTE_RELATED_PARTY_CONSTANTS.RTM_RESALE.ACCOUNT_ROLES); } else if (routeToMarket == QuoteConstants.QUOTE_RELATED_PARTY_CONSTANTS.RTM_OPTIONS.DISTRIBUTOR) { this.createRecordsForSellerOrganization(quoteGr, QuoteConstants.QUOTE_RELATED_PARTY_CONSTANTS.RTM_DISTRIBUTOR.CHANNEL_PARTNER_ROLES); this.createRecordsForAccount(quoteGr, QuoteConstants.QUOTE_RELATED_PARTY_CONSTANTS.RTM_DISTRIBUTOR.ACCOUNT_ROLES); } } catch (e) { gs.error('Error in createRelatedPartyRecords: ' + e.message); return; } }, validateRelatedParty: function(current, headerTable, relatedPartyTable, entityName) { var resultSuccess = { success: true, message: '' }; var resultForParentStateValidation = this.validateIfRelatedPartyParentRecordIsInCompletedState(current, headerTable, relatedPartyTable, entityName); if (!resultForParentStateValidation.success) { return resultForParentStateValidation; } var resultForPartyAlreadyAddedValidation = this.validateIfPartyAlreadyAddedAsRelatedParty(current, headerTable, relatedPartyTable, entityName); if (!resultForPartyAlreadyAddedValidation.success) { return resultForPartyAlreadyAddedValidation; } return resultSuccess; }, validateIfRelatedPartyParentRecordIsInCompletedState: function(current, headerTable, relatedPartyTable, entityName) { var result = { success: true, message: '' }; var quote = current.quote; if (current.getTableName() == QuoteConstants.QUOTE_LINE_RELATED_PARTY_ADDRESS_TABLE) quote = current.quote_line_item.quote; // Check if the parent record is in completed state var parentGr = new GlideRecord(headerTable); if (parentGr.get(quote)) { if (parentGr.getValue('state') == 'completed') { result.success = false; result.message = 'Cannot add or modify related parties for ' + ' "' + parentGr.getDisplayValue() + '" because it is already in completed state.'; } } return result; }, validateIfPartyAlreadyAddedAsRelatedParty: function(current, headerTable, relatedPartyTable, entityName) { var result = { success: true, message: '' }; var grRelatedParty = new GlideRecord(relatedPartyTable); grRelatedParty.addQuery(entityName, current[entityName]); if (current.getTableName() == QuoteConstants.QUOTE_LINE_RELATED_PARTY_ADDRESS_TABLE) grRelatedParty.addQuery('quote_line_item', current.quote_line_item); else { grRelatedParty.addQuery('quote', current.quote); } // Check if this party and role/type combination already exist for current quote if (GlidePluginManager.isActive('com.snc.business_organization_qm') && current.seller_organization != '') { grRelatedParty.addQuery('seller_organization', current.seller_organization); result.message = 'Related Party "' + current.seller_organization.getDisplayValue() + '" already has type ' + current.type.getDisplayValue(); } else { grRelatedParty.addQuery('account', current.account); result.message = 'Related Party "' + current.account.getDisplayValue() + '" already has type ' + current.type.getDisplayValue(); } grRelatedParty.addQuery('type', current.type); grRelatedParty.addActiveQuery(); // Exclude the current record if we're updating if (current.sys_id) { grRelatedParty.addQuery('sys_id', '!=', current.sys_id); } grRelatedParty.query(); if (grRelatedParty.next()) { result.success = false; } return result; }, hasRelatedPartyRecords: function(current) { var quoteSysID = current.sys_id; var result = { success: true, message: '' }; var grRPRecord = new GlideRecordSecure(QuoteConstants.QUOTE_RELATED_PARTY_TABLE); var qc = grRPRecord.addQuery('quote', quoteSysID); qc.addOrCondition('quote_line_item.quote', quoteSysID); grRPRecord.setLimit(1); grRPRecord.query(); if (grRPRecord.hasNext()) { result.success = false; result.message = QuoteMessage.INVOLVED_PARTY_ALREADY_EXIST; return result; } return result; }, type: 'QuoteRelatedPartyUtilOOB' };
